column1: # Git clones for the zsh framework, theme and zsh/tmux plugins (S3-clones).
# checked 2026-10-10: each zsh ref is the repository's default branch, as
# `git ls-remote --symref URL HEAD` reported it that day.
# Tab-separated; columns: id dest url ref hosts. ids match tools.tsv rows.
# ref is a branch name, never a commit: nothing here is pinned. A missing
# clone is made with `git clone --depth=1 --branch REF URL DEST`, and an
# existing one is never touched, so each tracks its upstream default branch
# the way oh-my-zsh's own `zstyle ':omz:update' mode auto` (common/zsh/.zshrc)
# keeps ~/.oh-my-zsh on master. docs/bootstrap.md S3-clones says how to update
# the theme and plugins by hand; downloads stay sha256-pinned in installers.tsv.
# ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh, cloned with the flags of its own installer (self-updating).
# tmux repositories verified 2026-11-01: their default branch is master.
# Customization plugins verified 2026-11-01 against upstream default branches.
# Catppuccin's TPM basename is tmux; the id avoids the native tmux tool row.
